feature_name: ReqSys DEV runner pool by capability
acceptance_criteria: Portable DEV workflows use shared capability labels and a fail-closed preflight
No portable critical workflow depends on DESKTOP-PDQK954 or a fixed runner_id
Runtime root and evidence identity come from the validated local manifest
HML, STG, PROD and automatic retry remain disabled
Onboarding validation does not register or reconfigure the GitHub runner service
Explicit label reconciliation uses a dedicated confirmation parameter without colliding with PowerShell common parameters
Physical onboarding receives no administrative secret and defers remote label reconciliation until after sanitized local-profile evidence
Hosted label reconciliation is owner-bound, evidence-bound, resolves one runner by labels, validates readback and never uses a fixed runner_id
The hosted reconciliation workflow is present in both the owner route and the fixed dispatch allowlist
A second registered PC can be onboarded through an approved bootstrap capability without hostname or runner_id affinity
Second-PC onboarding uploads sanitized evidence before one delayed listener restart and defers shared labels until online readback
Hosted pool monitoring and label reconciliation use short-lived governed GitHub App tokens instead of a personal PAT or machine-bound credential

Privileged PC24x7 onboarding reuses only the pre-existing S4U/highest admin broker task, independently revalidates the exact owner comment and immutable clean checkout, exposes no administrative secret, remains DEV/base-only and schedules one delayed runner restart

A non-elevated PC24x7 runtime route lets base and runtime preflights prefer a fixed user-scoped manifest when present, honors cumulative capability order, refuses reparse points across the path and does not alter the runner service or environment file

Runtime eligibility proves the current runner registration plus Docker CLI and a responding local Windows named-pipe Engine, and hosted reconciliation selects and confirms exactly one online idle runner
Missing GitHub App Administration and Actions permissions remain a fail-closed external prerequisite without PAT fallback
Runtime onboarding and label reconciliation reject direct dispatch by non-owner collaborators even when a fresh owner comment identifier is visible
The existing Windows PowerShell 5.1 CI job proves installer parameter binding reaches a fail-closed prerequisite without host mutation
